name: iran-2019-11
title: Iran, November 2019 - international shutdown with a live domestic network

source.event: Nationwide international internet shutdown, Iran, 16-27 November 2019
source.dataset: IODA gtr-norm (traffic to Google services, normalised), country IR
source.method: cah trace --country IR --start 2019-11-13 --end 2019-12-06 --baseline-days 3. Each sample is divided by the median of the same half-hour slot over 13-15 November, then segmented at levels 0, 0.02, 0.1, 0.5, 1. The 111 hours from 16 Nov 19:00 UTC sat between 0.7% and 1.9% and are replayed as one phase.

ir.description: Nodes inside the country, on the domestic network

phases.name: shutdown
phases.note: 16 Nov 19:00 to 21 Nov 10:00 UTC, 111 h. Median availability 0.7% to 1.9%; 0 of 50 nodes.

phases.name: trickle
phases.note: 21 Nov 10:00 to 22 Nov 20:00 UTC, 34 h. Median availability 3.6%; 2 of 50 nodes.

phases.name: partial-10
phases.note: 22 Nov 20:00 to 23 Nov 12:00 UTC, 16 h. Median availability 9.5%; 5 of 50 nodes.

phases.name: partial-60
phases.note: 23 Nov 12:00 to 27 Nov 15:00 UTC, 99 h. Median availability 59%; 30 of 50 nodes.

failed.title: Every pod applied every phase, on schedule
failed.detail: lateness p50 108 ms, p99 387 ms, max 628 ms over 900 applications; shaper off schedule (limit 500 ms)
